translation.name: Wakʉ Itekare: Emenna' Pe Ekonekan Nɨto'

content: Serɨ serɨ Sises tamokori ton ese' asi', kin pe te'sen Tepi' pa pe iyesi'pʉ, Epʉra'an pa pe nɨrɨ kanan iyesi'pʉ.

content.text: Seko' esi'pʉ Isuta mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ iyakon non kʉipʉnʉ pe,
Isuta esi'pʉ Peres mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ Sera pokon kʉipʉnʉ pe, Temarʉ esi'pʉ na'ne' to' san pe.
Sarʉman esi'pʉ Powas kʉipʉnʉ pe, Reyapu esi'pʉ na'ne' isan pe,
Powas esi'pʉ Ope' kʉipʉnʉ pe, Ru' esi'pʉ na'ne' isan pe,
Ise'si nin si esi'pʉ mɨrɨ Tepi' kin pe te'sen kʉipʉnʉ pe.

content: Tepi' esi'pʉ Saraman kʉipʉnʉ pe, Iuraya no'pʉ rʉ'pʉ esi'pʉ na'ne' isan pe,

content.text: Iso'saya esi'pʉ Ise'konaya mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ iyakon non kʉipʉnʉ pe. To' eyaton non uya Esuwerʉ amʉ' a'sisa' arɨ a'tai'ne Paperan pona.

content: Paperan pona Esuwerʉ amʉ' a'sisa' asa' to' eyaton non uya a'tai:

content.text: Seko' esi'pʉ Isose' kʉipʉnʉ pe, Meri taan'pʉ si. Meri esi'pʉ Sises san pe, Kʉrai

content: Epʉra'an awonsi'kɨ Tepi', kin pe te'sen pʉ'kʉ pona, 14 kaisa rɨ itamokori ton u'tɨsa' esi'pʉ mɨrɨ. Tepi', kin pe te'sen awonsi'kɨ, to' eyaton non uya Esuwerʉ amʉ' a'sisa' arɨ Paperan pona pʉ'kʉ pona, 14 kaisa rɨ itamokori ton u'tɨsa' esi'pʉ mɨrɨ. To' eyaton non uya Esuwerʉ amʉ' a'sisa' arɨ'pʉ Paperan pona awonsi'kɨ, Kʉrai entu pʉ'kʉ pona, 14 kaisa rɨ itamokori ton u'tɨsa' esi'pʉ mɨrɨ.

Serɨ serɨ, Sises Kʉrai entu'pʉ pantomʉ: Isanon pe te'ton kon, Meri, mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ Isose' pokon usauro'sa' esi'pʉ temari'mato' kon pe, e'tane to' uta'pɨtʉ rawɨrɨ rɨ, tʉumono'tasa' i'tu'pʉ Meri uya, Wakʉ A'kwarʉ winɨ.
Isose' esi'pʉ ipokena' pe te'sen, mɨrɨpan ekoneka'pʉ ama'ai imari'mato' tʉuya ereutanʉ'to' pe tʉuya.

Mɨrɨ pɨ' isenuminka'pʉ tʉpo, Papa inserʉʉi uyee'pʉ ipiya' iye'ne'pɨtʉ yau, mɨrɨpan uya ta'pʉ ipɨ', “Isose', Tepi' pa rʉ'pʉ, tenari'nʉnse pʉra Meri anʉnkɨ ɨno'pʉ pe, apʉne pʉra Wakʉ A'kwarʉ winɨ imono'tasa' mɨrɨ.
Warawo' pe entunʉ'to' iya oton, imʉre mese'tɨi' Sises
tukai', apʉne pʉra tʉtonpa ton pika'tɨto' iya oton pe iyesi pɨ' to' makooi apai,” ta'pʉ iya.
Serɨ e'kupʉ'pʉ pena Papa usaurokʉ'pʉ pu'kena' Aisaya awɨrɨ a'ku'tɨnin pe:
“A'pɨ'pʉn uri'san umono'tato' oton, mɨrɨpan entuto' oton warawo' pe, mɨrɨpan esa'to' oton to' uya Maniwerʉ tukai' tawon,”
ta'pʉ iya, “Papa esi upiyau'nokon” ta e'kwa pe.
Isose' upakasa' uya nin si, Meri mari'ma'pʉ mɨrɨ, Itepuru inserʉʉi uya tauro'ka'pʉ awɨrɨ, mɨrɨpan uya arɨ'pʉ tiwʉ' ta',
e'tane iyentu rawɨrɨ a'pɨ'pɨtʉ'pʉ iya pen. Mɨrɨpan mʉre entusa' ese'tɨ'pʉ iya “Sises” tukai'.

footnotes.text: Kʉrai (Kiri' maimu yau); mɨrɨ pe pʉra, Me'saya (Ipuru maimu yau), asa'rɨ rɨ marɨ iyesi, Papa Nanʉmʉ'pʉ ta e'kwa pe. Apʉne, v. 17-18 enkɨ.
Sises esi Kiri' maimu Isa'suwa awonsi'kɨ, Itepuru uya to' pika'tɨ ta e'kwa pe.
